absences: No in-window (after 2026-11-19) event for the 1-20 MW market could be found with a dated primary or fetched source. Searches for Radiant, Antares, Aalo, Valar, Westinghouse eVinci, Last Energy, Kairos, Standard Nuclear, Natura, Deep Fission, NANO Nuclear and Deployable Energy returned nothing dated after 2026-11-19.
Last Energy PWR-5 / PWR-20 criticality: still not announced as of the latest found coverage (early November 2026); DSA approval was 2026-10-07 and is already shipped. No criticality date to file.

Nuclea Energy / Moltex (web-leads): definitive agreement dated 2026-08-14 by WNN publication date, outside the 60-day gap window. Not filed. The 2026-11-20 date in the lead could not be confirmed; the SPAC close target is H1 2027.
Berkeley Odin prototype (web-leads): WNN article dated 2026-07-07, Chiltern Vital Group and Cambridge Atomworks letter of intent, operational target 2030. Outside the window. Not filed.
Blykalla / Urenco SEALER HALEU enrichment (candidates.json, POWER 2026-11-19): 55 MWe lead-cooled reactor, outside the 1-20 MW band. Not filed.
Radiant TRISO fuel delivered to DOME (WNN 2026-07-03): fabricated by Standard Nuclear, first shipment for full-power testing. Dated 2026-07-03, outside the gap window. Not filed.

Oklo Aurora-INL concrete and steel placement (announced on X 2026-11-11, per ANS 2026-11-16): Aurora-INL is 75 MWe, outside the band. Groves-1 unrestricted operations and Centrus-Oklo HALEU are already shipped.

Terrestrial Energy Ameresco Aberdeen Proving Ground selection (Army announcement 2026-09-21, one day before the gap window): 390 MWe IMSR plant reported but not confirmed by the Army. Outside band and window. Terrestrial Q3 results (2026-11-10) add only NRC topical report submissions with no MW or date figures; not filed.
Hyundai E&C with ARC Clean Technology (ARC-100 / 200 MWe demonstration at INL) and Hyundai E&C with FANCO (EAGL-1, 240 MWe; master service agreement 2026-10-30): outside band. Not filed.

X-energy TRISO-X president Joel Duling retirement effective 2026-11-20 (citybiz repost; primary page returned HTTP 403): subsidiary fuel-plant personnel for a 80 MWe-class reactor program, outside band. Not filed.
Westinghouse eVinci high-temperature zero-power test (Westinghouse release dated 2026-09-15): follow-up to the already-shipped 2026-08-24 criticality, and outside the gap window. Not filed.
Standard Nuclear two-facility TRISO plan (ANS 2026-07-24) and Framatome Richland line: dated before the gap window. Not filed.
LOTUS test bed (INL): May 2026 NRIC slides give March 2027 groundbreaking and mid-to-late 2028 operations; no 2026 event to file. Background only.
Personnel: no microreactor-company CEO or executive appointment found for the window. Hadron Energy EVP engineering hire and NANO Nuclear CTO hire were not dated to the window and were not fetched.
Launch Pad: no DOE or NRIC Launch Pad announcement dated after 2026-08-24 found; the 2026-08-24/25 second round is already shipped.
Holtec SMR-300 and General Atomics microreactor: no 2026-11 news found; Holtec items are 2024-2025 background.
